ElementDescription: Composite Score: Measure of Overall Social Functioning
Independence Rating and Score
Notes: 0=Living independently; 1=In semi-structured accommodation (or still at home) but with high degree of autonomy; 2=Living with parents, some limited autonomy; 3=In residential accommodation with some limited autonomy; 4=Specialist autistic or other residential accommodation with little or no autonomy; 5=In hospital care or at home because nowhere else would accept the individual.

ElementDescription: Relation to informant - Other(specify)
Occupation rating
Notes: 0= Professionals; 1= Computer programmers, etc.; 2= Non-manual skilled (e.g., typist, police officer); 3= Manual skilled (e.g., toolmaker, postal worker); 4= Partly skilled (e.g., bus driver); 5= Unskilled; 6= Unemployed, but not due to physical or mental disability; 7= Homemaker; 8= Unemployed because of physical or mental handicap; 9= Still in full-time education; 88= N/A, currently age 15.11 years or younger; 99= N/K

ElementDescription: Vocational Index
Notes: 1=No vocational/educational activities; 2=Volunteering with no other activities or postsecondary non-degree seeking education with no other activities; 3=Sheltered vocational setting - total activities 10hr per week or less; 4=Sheltered vocational setting (workshop or day activity center) with no community employment/volunteering - greater than 10hr per week; 4=Sheltered vocational setting and volunteering in the community - total activities greater than 10hr per week; 5=Sheltered vocational setting and supported community employment - total activities greater than 10hr per week; 6=Employed in the community with supports (no time spent in sheltered settings) - total activities 10hr per week or less; 7=Employed in the community with supports greater than 10hr per week, no time spent in sheltered setting; 8=Post-secondary degree-seeking educational program, or employment in the community without supports - total activities 10hr per week or less; 9=Post-secondary degree-seeking educational program greater than 10hr per week; 9=Employment in the community without supports greater than 10hr per week

ElementDescription: Relation to informant
Education rating
Notes: 0=No educational qualifications (no high school diploma or GED); 1=High school diploma or GED; 2=Partial college/university, technical college graduate, one or more years of full-time study leading to a diploma/certificate (e.g., secretarial); 3=University/polytechnic graduate; 4=Post-graduate education; 8=Not school age, or old enough too have completed high school diploma or GED; 9=N/K

ElementDescription: Friendship Rating and Score
Notes: 0=No problem, one or more real friends; 1=At least one friendship that involves some personal shared activities outside a pre-arranged situation with some initiative taken by subject, but limited in terms of restricted interests or less than normal responsiveness/reciprocity; 2=People with whom subject has some kind of personal relationship involving seeking of contact but only in group situations (clubs, school) or in school or at work; 3=Definitely does not mix, socially isolated no peer relationships that involve selectivity and sharing, no friends, no joint activities; 8=Less than 5 years of age or unusual serious lack of opportunity for peer contact; 9=N/K

ElementDescription: Work Rating
Notes: 0=Employed or self-employed; 1=Voluntary work/job training or low-pay scheme; 2=Supported/sheltered employment; 3=In special center/no occupation
